about.description: CRCLX is a single-stock perpetual listed on Delta Exchange India, tracking Circle Internet Group, Inc., margined and cash-settled in USD. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 25× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
